dedupe_keys.name: mc dc monte carlo neutron transport

description: MC/DC is a Python Monte Carlo code for time-dependent neutron transport. Users define a geometry, material interaction data and particle sources; the code samples neutron histories and tallies their movement and reactions with estimated statistical error. Its methods are designed for dynamic problems and high-performance computing, including nuclear criticality safety studies relevant to nuclear facilities. The spatial and temporal domain are those of the supplied geometry and scenario, not a fixed reactor or site. The JOSS-linked public source and documentation are BSD-3-Clause. Its outputs can support comparison of nuclear-system shielding or safety scenarios and the development of faster transport algorithms. A caveat is that stochastic error and cross-section quality affect every result, while code verification tests do not establish safety for a specific facility. The repository README points to a newer development organization with a different repository identity; this draft identifies the repository linked by the paper and records that distinction. No existing catalogue record or first-review draft matched it. Source documentation was read without running a criticality case.
